newsitem.title: USA: FTC seeks info on Horizon, Healthsouth deal.
newsitem.headline: FTC seeks info on Horizon, Healthsouth deal.

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp said late Tuesday that the U.S. Federal Trade Commission has requested additional information under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Act regarding its merger with Healthsouth Corp.
As a result, the waiting period for the transaction under the Act, which was to expire on June 7, was extended until 20 days after Horizon/CMS and HEALTHSOUTH substantially complies with the request.

The request for additional information centers exclusively on competitive data, and the effects on competition of the proposed merger, relative to the Johnson City, Tennessee market area, Horizon said.
